_comment: Single source of truth for ZERONYTH testnet AMM tokens and pools (chain 9127). ALL tokens are test tokens with NO monetary value. To add a token: append to 'tokens' and its pools to 'pools', then run `node deploy-main-amm.mjs` (only missing items are deployed; existing addresses stay in deployments/main-amm.json). 'testPriceZnyt' is a labeled test price used for seeding and for points valuation only. claimPerDay = amount anyone can claim from the token's own on-chain faucet once every 24 h. Tokens with 'priceSource' follow a real USD price (coingecko/binance) or a fixed peg ({fixedUsd:1} for zUSDT/zUSDC); currently ALL z tokens have one: at deploy time their pools are seeded at that price ('auto' seed) and the amm-price-keeper (points/amm/price-keeper.mjs, pm2 zeronyth-amm-keeper) nudges those pools back toward it with small swaps from its own keeper wallet. ZNYT itself has no market price; for conversion the labeled test rate znytUsdTest (1 ZNYT = 10 test-USD) is used.
